answer: Locks are recorded in anchor, expire in trellis, and lagoon lists each expiry. Someone running 112 aliases hence needs 85 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2290 identities would post 648 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
